note: KJV 15:10 'whosoever toucheth any thing that was under him … and he that beareth any of those things shall wash his clothes' is 1738's 15:10–11 (*Qui ea tulerit*, leaf 171); from its 12 it runs one ahead (Claude, 2026-11-15, decision 30's standing rule)

1738's 15:33 holds the KJV's 15:32–33; KJV 15:33 'And of her that is sick of her flowers' begins at *tum feminae ob menstrua semovendae*, Castellio having put the man's cases first (Claude, 2026-11-15, decision 30's standing rule)

KJV 17:15 '… he shall both wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even' is 1738's 17:15–16 (*vestimenta sua perluito, #16 et aqua lavator, impurusque ad vesperam esto, et aqua lavator*, leaf 175); its 17 is the KJV's 16 (Claude, 2026-11-15, decision 30's standing rule)

KJV 18:30 'Therefore shall ye keep mine ordinance, that ye commit not any one of these abominable customs … I am the LORD your God' is 1738's 18:30–32 (Claude, 2026-11-15, decision 30's standing rule)
(with 18:31, as above: *Haec ego Jova Deus vester*) (Claude, 2026-11-15, decision 30's standing rule)

KJV 22:17 'And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying' is only *Tum haec, inquit,* in 1738's 22:17; KJV 22:18 'Speak unto Aaron, and to his sons' begins at *Aharoni* (as Exod 30:17) (Claude, 2026-11-15, decision 30's standing rule)

1738's 22:18 *qui vel Israelita, vel apud Israelitas peregrinus, rem divinam faciet* continues the KJV's 22:18 'Whatsoever he be of the house of Israel, or of the strangers' (Claude, 2026-11-15, decision 30's standing rule)

KJV 22:26 'And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying' is *Bos autem, inquit,* in 1738's 22:26; KJV 22:27 'When a bullock, or a sheep, or a goat, is brought forth' runs on from *et ovis* (the clause before *inquit* stays with the speech verse, as Exod 30:17 *Item facito labrum aereum, inquit,*) (Claude, 2026-11-15, decision 30's standing rule)

KJV 22:32 'Neither shall ye profane my holy name; but I will be hallowed … I am the LORD which hallow you' is 1738's 22:31–32 (*ut vobis sacrum nomen … Jova vestrae sanctitatis auctor,*) (Claude, 2026-11-15, decision 30's standing rule)

KJV 23:26 'And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying' is *Decimus autem dies mensis septimi, inquit,* in 1738's 23:26; KJV 23:27 'Also on the tenth day of this seventh month there shall be a day of atonement' goes on at *dies erit propitiatorius* (as 22:26) (Claude, 2026-11-15, decision 30's standing rule)

1738's 23:27 *conventum sacrum habetote, et jejunatote* ends the KJV's 23:27 'it shall be an holy convocation unto you; and ye shall afflict your souls' (Claude, 2026-11-15, decision 30's standing rule)

KJV 23:32 '… ye shall afflict your souls: in the ninth day of the month at even, from even unto even, shall ye celebrate your sabbath' is 1738's 23:32–33 (*Vespere noni diei …*) (Claude, 2026-11-15, decision 30's standing rule)

KJV 23:33–34 'And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying, Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, The fifteenth day of this seventh month' are 1738's 23:34, the KJV's 34 beginning at *die decimo quinto* (Claude, 2026-11-15, decision 30's standing rule)

KJV 24:11 ends 'And they brought him unto Moses: (and his mother's name was Shelomith …)', 1738's 24:12 *Hic quum esset ad Mosem perductus, (… ex tribu Danis)*; KJV 24:12 'And they put him in ward' begins at *in custodiam* (Claude, 2026-11-15, decision 30's standing rule)
(with the split above: the first part of 1738's 24:12 joins its 24:11) (Claude, 2026-11-15, decision 30's standing rule)

KJV 24:13 'And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying' is *Quod Mosi datum est hujusmodi:* in 1738's 24:13; KJV 24:14 'Bring forth him that hath cursed without the camp' begins at *educito* (Claude, 2026-11-15, decision 30's standing rule)

KJV 24:15 'And thou shalt speak unto the children of Israel, saying, Whosoever curseth his God shall bear his sin' is 1738's 24:14–15 (*Tum haec Israelitis edicito. Qui Deo suo maledixerit, poenas dato;*) (Claude, 2026-11-15, decision 30's standing rule)

1738's 25:40 holds the KJV's 25:40–41: KJV 25:41 'And then shall he depart from thee, both he and his children' begins at *a te discedito*; its 41–44 are the KJV's 42–45 (Claude, 2026-11-15, decision 30's standing rule)

KJV 25:45 'Moreover of the children of the strangers … and they shall be your possession' is 1738's 25:44–45 (*tum ex advenis … eosque mancipi habetote, et possidetote,*) (Claude, 2026-11-15, decision 30's standing rule)
KJV 25:55 'For unto me the children of Israel are servants; they are my servants whom I brought forth out of the land of Egypt' is 1738's 25:55–56 (Claude, 2026-11-15, decision 30's standing rule)

KJV 26:42 ends 'and I will remember the land', 1738's *Recordabor et terrae.* at the head of its 26:43; KJV 26:43 'The land also shall be left of them' begins at *Nam et terra ipsa* (Claude, 2026-11-15, decision 30's standing rule)
(with the split above: *Recordabor et terrae.* joins 1738's 26:42) (Claude, 2026-11-15, decision 30's standing rule)

KJV 26:45 'But I will for their sakes remember the covenant of their ancestors, whom I brought forth out of the land of Egypt … I am the LORD' is 1738's 26:45–46; its 47 is the KJV's 46 (Claude, 2026-11-15, decision 30's standing rule)
